description: Source code for error handling in etcd v2 API, defining error codes, error struct, and related methods.

classes.name: Error
classes.description: Represents an error with code, message, cause, and index, and methods for JSON serialization and HTTP response.

methods.name: NewError
methods.description: Creates a new Error instance with specified code, cause, and index.

methods.name: Error
methods.description: Returns the error message with cause, implements error interface.

methods.name: toJSONString
methods.description: Serializes the Error to JSON string.

methods.name: StatusCode
methods.description: Returns the HTTP status code corresponding to the error code.

methods.name: WriteTo
methods.description: Writes the error as JSON to an HTTP response.
